pr_title: demo: covered path — search CLI command shipped with tests

findings.title: Uncovered CLI list command
findings.explanation: `list_cmd` is reported as uncovered by the test mapping analysis, so there is no direct test exercising the CLI list behavior.
findings.suggestion: Add a CLI/unit test for `list_cmd` that verifies it loads notes from the store and prints or returns the expected list output, including an empty-store case if applicable.

findings.title: Uncovered CLI show command
findings.explanation: `show` is reported as uncovered by the test mapping analysis, leaving the CLI note-display behavior untested.
findings.suggestion: Add a CLI/unit test for `show` that verifies displaying an existing note by identifier and the behavior when the requested note does not exist.

findings.title: Uncovered token matching helper
findings.explanation: `_token_matches` is reported as uncovered, even though it appears to contain search matching logic that likely affects query behavior.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for `_token_matches` covering positive and negative token matches, including relevant edge cases such as case sensitivity, missing fields, or special token syntax if supported.

findings.title: Tag search matches partial substrings instead of whole tags
findings.explanation: The `tag:` matcher uses plain substring containment. This makes `tag:#foo` match text like `#foobar`, `prefix#foo`, or `#foo-bar`, despite the docstring describing tags as literal tokens. That can return surprising false positives as soon as similar tag names exist.
findings.suggestion: Match tags as tokens rather than substrings, for example with `tag in note.text.split()` if whitespace-delimited tags are intended, or a regex that enforces tag boundaries.

findings.title: Uncovered age matching helper
findings.explanation: `_age_matches` is reported as uncovered, so age-based filtering helper behavior is not directly verified.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for `_age_matches` covering notes inside and outside the requested age range, boundary conditions, and invalid or absent age criteria if applicable.

findings.title: Age filtering can crash on naive timestamps
findings.explanation: `now` is always timezone-aware (`dt.UTC`), but `dt.datetime.fromisoformat(...)` may return a naive datetime for existing/legacy notes whose `created_at` lacks `Z` or an offset. Subtracting an aware datetime from a naive one raises `TypeError`, which is not caught, so an `age:` search can crash the CLI instead of simply not matching.
findings.suggestion: Normalize parsed timestamps before subtraction, e.g. if `created.tzinfo is None`, assume UTC with `created = created.replace(tzinfo=dt.UTC)`, or make both datetimes consistently naive/aware. Consider catching `TypeError` if malformed stored data is possible.

findings.title: Uncovered length matching helper
findings.explanation: `_len_matches` is reported as uncovered, leaving length-based search filtering behavior untested.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for `_len_matches` covering matching and non-matching note lengths, boundary values, and behavior with empty note content if applicable.

findings.title: Search token dispatch is brittle and hard to extend
findings.explanation: `_token_matches` is a stringly-typed dispatch chain with repeated `startswith(...)` checks and magic slice lengths (`token[5:]`, `token[4:]`). It is still small, but this pattern is brittle as more query operators are added and makes validation behavior spread across branches.
findings.suggestion: Parse once with `field, sep, value = token.partition(':')`, then dispatch through a small mapping such as `{ 'text': ..., 'tag': ..., 'age': ..., 'len': ... }`, falling back to bare-text matching when there is no recognized prefix.

findings.explanation: Public test function is missing a docstring describing the expected parsing behavior for supported age units.
findings.suggestion: Add a one-line docstring such as: "Verify that age expressions with supported units are parsed into timedeltas."

summary: No high-severity blockers were found, but several medium issues remain around search correctness: tag matching uses partial substrings and age filtering can crash on naive timestamps. Test coverage gaps also affect CLI commands and search helpers.
